title: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
abstract: arXiv:2611.28195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. translated_title: torchtsetlin：面向 PyTorch 的快速、可解释的 Tsetlin 机
translated_abstract: Tsetlin 机通过由奖励和惩罚（而非梯度）驱动的 Tsetlin 自动机团队来学习命题规则，因此其模型天然具备可解释性且评估成本很低。然而，其现有软件是位于 scikit-learn 风格封装背后的 C 和 CUDA 内核，游离于深度学习生态系统之外。torchtsetlin 将 Tsetlin 机家族实现为普通的 PyTorch 模块：包括基础版与加权版、合并版、回归版、面向序列、图像和三维体积的卷积版，以及稠密的逐像素分割版。自动机作为张量缓冲区存在，因此模型可以通过 .to(device) 迁移设备、通过 state_dict() 保存，并通过一次 update(x,y) 调用完成一个小批量的学习。其核心技术是 Type I 和 Type II 反馈的批量化表述，其中自动机状态转移变为以二项式抽样实现的事件计数，每个小批量只需一次提交。在取自现有库的十个基准测试中，它……
tldr: torchtsetlin 将 Tsetlin 机家族实现为标准 PyTorch 模块，其核心技术是 Type I/II 反馈的批量化表述（自动机转移转化为二项式抽样的事件计数，每小批量一次提交），使这一可解释模型首次无缝融入深度学习生态并获得高效训练。
en_tdlr: torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin Machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules, with its core technique being a batched formulation of Type I/II feedback where automaton transitions become event counts realized as binomial draws—one commit per mini-batch—enabling seamless integration into the deep learning ecosystem.
